name: ppt-master
description: Generate natively editable PPTX from PDF / DOCX / URL / Markdown — real DrawingML shapes, text boxes, charts, and animations, via an AI-driven multi-format SVG content generation pipeline (Strategist -> Executor live preview -> quality check -> post-processing -> export). Ships a large icon/template/reference library. Note: run `pip install -r requirements.txt` inside skills/ppt-master/ for the Python post-processing scripts to work.
